note: Small Alberta Parks recreation area campground on Ole's Lake, NW of Cleardale in Clear Hills County, run by the Cherry Canyon Agricultural Society. Sites string along a road up the east shore, mostly in trees; the north end of the road opens onto the water. Boat launch, pier, hand launch, fish cleaning station and playground; bring drinking water (the pump is not potable). --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (Jun 18, 2026): 18 unserviced FCFS sites at C$20, vault toilets, non-potable pump confirmed; season 05-15..09-30 added; leaseholder Cherry Canyon Agricultural Society, phone 780-595-2155; lakeview kept (a lakefront lead at the road's north end, unconfirmed as a site).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, checked hard): keep lakeview. The 2017 map strings sites 2-17 along a road that runs north up the east shore; on imagery (Esri, ~0.49 m/px) that road is 40-50 m from the water behind a band of spruce for most of its length (sites 6-13), and the small loop by the washroom (map 14-15) has a grassy clearing ~40 m from the shore with a tree fringe. LEAD: at the road's north end (map site 17, around 56.3159,-119.8920) an open gravel lobe reaches to within ~5-10 m of the water through a thin fringe. It could be site 17's pad, a turnaround or the page's 'hand launch', so it is not placed with confidence; if AWH confirms it as site 17, lakefront with a caveat naming site 17 would follow. Recommend lakeview until then.
OPERATOR: page 'Leaseholder: Cherry Canyon Agricultural Society'. Ownership stays provincial (an Alberta Parks PRA); no ownership change recommended.
